When PCSK9 is overactive, fewer LDL receptors remain on the cell surface, leading to higher circulating LDL cholesterol.

This mechanism made it a major drug target. Monoclonal antibody inhibitors (like evolocumab and alirocumab) and a small interfering RNA therapy (inclisiran) were developed to block PCSK9, significantly lowering LDL cholesterol, especially in patients with familial hypercholesterolemia or statin intolerance.
